title: Mythic mob with a Model Engine model
description: Making an NPC from a MythicMobs mob that shows its Model Engine model

files.MythicMobs/Mobs/animus.yml:
AnimusMeg:
  Type: ZOMBIE
  Display: 'Knight'
  Skills:
  - model{mid=knight} @self ~onSpawn
  - message{m="<caster.name> greets <trigger.name>"} @trigger ~onInteract
AnimusKing:
  Type: SKELETON
  Display: 'Skeleton King'
  Equipment:
  - GOLDEN_HELMET:4
  - BOW HAND
  Options:
    Glowing: true
  Skills:
  - message{m="The Skeleton King nods at <trigger.name>"} @trigger ~onInteract
  - message{m="<trigger.name> struck the Skeleton King"} @trigger ~onDamaged
  - message{m="The Skeleton King watches the field"} @PlayersInRadius{r=24} ~onTimer:160

made: animus npc model knight interact wave

beats.note: the NPC must exist before the cue sets its interact animation

beats.result: the reply line and the knight NPC appearing behind the player
the Mythic mob as an NPC wearing its Model Engine knight
the knight waves and the Mythic skill says Knight greets the player
the greeting again from the new angle

closing: The Mythic mob NPC shows its knight model and greets on click
